```{r}
#Vectors
cell_ID_A<-"CX1"
cell_ID_B<-"CX2"

treated_A<-TRUE
treated_B<-FALSE

cell_num_before_A<-5415
cell_num_before_B<-8123

cell_num_after_A<-1432
cell_num_after_B<-7543


cell_id_vec <- c(cell_ID_A,cell_ID_B)
treated_vec <- c(treated_A,treated_B)
no_before_vec <- c(cell_num_before_A,cell_num_before_B)
no_after_vec <- c(cell_num_after_A,cell_num_after_B)
```

```{r}
#Indexing

```

```{r}
#Creating a data frame
cell_ID_A<-"CX1"
cell_ID_B<-"CX2"

treated_A<-TRUE
treated_B<-FALSE

cell_num_before_A<-5415
cell_num_before_B<-8123

cell_num_after_A<-1432
cell_num_after_B<-7543


cell_id_vec <- c(cell_ID_A,cell_ID_B)
treated_vec <- c(treated_A,treated_B)
no_before_vec <- c(cell_num_before_A,cell_num_before_B)
no_after_vec <- c(cell_num_after_A,cell_num_after_B)

my_data_frame<-tibble(
  cell_ID=cell_id_vec,
  treated=treated_vec,
  num_cells_before=no_before_vec,
  num_cells_after=no_after_vec
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
